title: Long Now Foundation: Incorruptible by Design
summary: The Long Now Foundation runs its talks series on civilization-scale timescales; Eric's, at the Cowell Theater in Fort Mason Center in San Francisco, was hosted by Denise Hearn, the foundation's Director of Strategic Initiatives. He proposed redefining profit as the maximization of human flourishing and described what he calls mission transmission, building a company around a coherent set of values so that profit follows from them.
blockquote: How do we architect accountability mechanisms that outlive their creators? What governance structures remain resilient across generations of technological, economic, and cultural transformation?

type_metadata.details: The recorded talk is now available to watch at longnow.org.
